jobs.name: LoneLantern
jobs.prompt:
Arcane Brigade Waiting Realm RELIC ICON, hand-painted storybook rendering, warm ink line, soft painterly shading: dream-like waiting room / after-hours toy shop, dark lacquered wood, brass and gilt filigree, aged paper and ink, deep velvet, warm lantern glow, gentle melancholy with whimsy. Single centered object or cohesive described assemblage, filling about80% square512x512 canvas with clear10% margins. Truly transparent RGBA background, no frame/card/badge behind object, no text letters numbers, no floor/cast shadow. Slight three-quarter view. LoneLantern.png: a single small brass hand-lantern burning bright amber, its glass a little cracked, a short frayed ribbon tied to the handle; the only warm thing in the picture.
